verdict.rationale: Termius ships its own Mosh protocol support. The docs say to enable Mosh "when you need connection stability while changing networks," and a community user praises the free Mosh support, which covers the core of keeping sessions alive across network changes. Survival across device sleep is only implied by Mosh's nature and is never explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of session persistence across device sleep/suspend, documented auto-reconnect or keep-alive behavior for SSH sessions, hands-on corroboration of Mosh roaming in Termius
